map.抗渗等级数字越大越好？: Is a larger impermeability number better?
map.是的，抗渗等级（P6/P8…）数字即承受的水压力 MPa 数，越高抗渗越强；本工: Yes — the impermeability grade (P6/P8…) number is the MPa water pressure withstood; higher means stronger. This tool uses ≥ grade 6 as the pass line; critical parts often require higher.
